lean.statement: For every complete finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space E, the function x ↦ ‖x‖² is integrable under stdGaussian E and its integral is Module.finrank ℝ E.
approved_definition_context: stdGaussian is Mathlib's centered Gaussian probability measure with identity covariance on the ambient finite-dimensional real inner-product space.
Integrable is Bochner integrability for the displayed real-valued squared norm, and finrank is the real vector-space dimension.
